name: ShoppingErrands

custom.system_prompt: You are generating household conversations where an assistant identifies shopping needs and errands without explicit requests.

initial_prompt: Create a household conversation where people casually mention needs and tasks without formal requests, and the assistant identifies actionable items, updates lists, or sets reminders appropriately without being intrusive.

user1.name: HouseholdMember1
user1.role: Adult household member who manages most of the grocery shopping and household inventory

user2.name: HouseholdMember2
user2.role: Adult household member who notices household needs but often doesn't directly add them to lists

user3.name: HouseholdMember3
user3.role: Younger household member who mentions needs casually and expects others to remember

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Household assistant that monitors conversations for mentions of needed items, tasks, or errands, updating lists and providing reminders at appropriate times without explicit requests
